description:
Declare the rule names of the built-in validation passes as one closed vocabulary in the validation layer, so `crates/jit/src/validation/` no longer imports them from `commands`.

## Background

- `DANGLING_LINK_RULE`, `ENFORCEMENT_DRIFT_RULE` and `REVIEW_PLACEHOLDER_RULE` are `&str` constants in `crates/jit/src/commands/validate.rs:12,19,23`, re-exported at `commands/mod.rs:97`. Repository validation reads them from `commands` (`crates/jit/src/validation/repository.rs:622,646,769,832`), and spells the fourth built-in name, `rules-file`, as a literal (`:215`). `commands/validate.rs:1605` spells it again.
- Other readers: `commands/validate.rs` (dangling, drift and placeholder passes), `commands/gate_check.rs:513,592,597` and tests (`validation/repository.rs:1006,1236,1263`, `commands/gate_check.rs:2908,3048`, `crates/jit/tests/cli_item_validate/item_cli_tests.rs`, `cli_item_validate/validate_cli_rule_tests.rs`, `cli_repo_workflow/profile_acceptance_tests.rs`).
- Closed vocabularies are declared through the crate's wire-vocabulary macro (`domain/vocabulary.rs`), which emits `as_str`, `ALL`, `FromStr` and serde from one list.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: A `BuiltInPass` vocabulary in the validation layer, declared through the wire-vocabulary macro, names `rules-file`, `dangling-item-link`, `enforcement-drift` and `review-placeholder`, and every built-in finding takes its rule name from it.
- [hard] REQ-02: The three `commands` constants and their re-export no longer exist, and no code spells a built-in pass name as a string literal outside the vocabulary declaration and tests that assert wire output.
- [hard] REQ-03: Findings keep their wire rule names: the existing validation and gate suites pass unchanged.

## Notes

- Behaviour is unchanged.
- Written against the code as it stands after the changes this one follows; line citations name current code.
title: Built-in validation pass names are one validation-layer vocabulary
